team.collaboration: Collaborate only within the team under contest rules.

execution.turn_budget_basis: official clock 15 turns vs floor 11 (3 teammates x 2 turns + 1 answer parts + 4 for synthesis)

human_constraints: You must behave like a human teammate under official contest rules.
Do not claim tools, internet, or materials that the rule card forbids.
Do not look up answer keys or hidden solutions.
No electronic devices at any stage; treat writing as handwritten.
Stage 1: team plans only, no drafting the essays yet.
Stage 2: each teammate writes one essay individually.
Stage 3: peer edit is allowed, but you may not finish a teammate's unfinished essay.
Submit three essays, one per teammate.
Team of 3 (event design: each member answers a different prompt; team writes three of three-to-four prompts).
Staged workflow: prepare with teammates (but not devices) → write individually → review one another's work at the end.
Official page emphasizes pen/pencil writing; device ban during prep is explicit on the events page.
Deliverable: handwritten essays / creative or persuasive pieces judged by Collaborative Writing Rubric (linked from events page).

agent_roles.name: Agent_1
agent_roles.title: planner / editor
duties: Run the planning stage and fix the outline before writing starts.
Edit for the rubric during the peer-edit stage, not for taste.
Submit only after the format and rule checks pass.

agent_roles.name: Agent_2
agent_roles.title: writer A
duties: Draft the assigned section in full prose, not notes.
Keep the section within its word or time budget.

agent_roles.name: Agent_3
agent_roles.title: writer B
duties: Draft the assigned section in full prose, not notes.
Keep the section within its word or time budget.

answer_format: Submit three essays or the staged writing portfolio required by the prompt.
evaluation_guidance: The contestant-facing evaluation brief emphasizes focus and argumentation, effective use of theme and evidence, style and clarity, and originality and persuasiveness. Writers receive these priorities without the captain's timing and workflow rules.

information_policy.coordination_requirement: The planner holds the stage and submission rules while the writers hold public evaluation guidance. They must exchange constraints and quality priorities through discussion or the shared scratchpad.

rules_text: World Scholar's Cup — Collaborative Writing. The team of 3 moves through fixed stages: plan together, write individually, then peer-edit before submission. Collaborate only within the team under contest rules. The team files one shared submission. Official timing note: 75 minutes total: 20 plan + 40 write + 15 peer edit.

adaptations: max_turns is a safety budget, not necessarily the official wall-clock limit
specialist roles are a research roster overlay
physical/oral/live opponent fidelity may be incomplete in src/
